title: Stop Memorizing Interview Answers (Do This Instead)
description:
If you freeze, ramble, or blank during interviews, this is probably why. Stop memorizing answers and start organizing your stories instead. This simple interview strategy helps you answer behavioral interview questions more naturally and confidently.

#InterviewTips #JobSearch #InterviewPrep #CareerAdvice #BehavioralInterview
transcript: You will freeze in your interview if you're trying to remember answers, and that's why you blank, that's why you ramble. Because the minute someone says, "Tell me about a time when," your brain just goes blank. Here's the fix. Stop memorizing answers and start organizing your stories. Five buckets: teamwork, problem-solving, communications, achievements, growth. Pick two to three stories for each, and now you're never scrambling. Same story, multiple answers, total game-changer. I'm Kate Kerschner, career strategist, and if you want to stop freezing and start sounding confident, go watch the full video on this strategy and follow along.
